maddeler.e:
نتناقض (form VI)
# نَتَنَاقَضُ (natanāqaḍu) /na.ta.naː.qa.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاقَضَ (tanāqaḍa)
# نَتَنَاقَضَ (natanāqaḍa) /na.ta.naː.qa.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاقَضَ (tanāqaḍa)
# نَتَنَاقَضْ (natanāqaḍ) /na.ta.naː.qadˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاقَضَ (tanāqaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
